arguments.sql_query:
WITH ssri_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (21604709, 797617, 715939, 755695, 751412, 722031, 739138)
), ssri_eras AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_era_start_date, de.drug_era_end_date, de.drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.drug_era de
  JOIN ssri_concepts sc ON sc.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
), first_ssri AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_era_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM ssri_eras
  GROUP BY person_id
), eligible AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date
  FROM first_ssri f
  JOIN omop.observation_period op
    ON op.person_id = f.person_id
   AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, CAST(f.index_date AS date))
   AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 180, CAST(f.index_date AS date))
), status AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, e.index_date,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM ssri_eras s
           WHERE s.person_id = e.person_id
             AND CAST(s.drug_era_start_date AS date) <= DATEADD(day, 180, CAST(e.index_date AS date))
             AND CAST(s.drug_era_end_date AS date) >= DATEADD(day, 180, CAST(e.index_date AS date))
         ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS discontinued_by_6mo
  FROM eligible e
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_ssri_users_with_365d_prior_180d_followup,
       SUM(discontinued_by_6mo) AS discontinued_by_6mo,
       CAST(1.0 * SUM(discontinued_by_6mo) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS discontinuation_proportion
FROM status

Observed 6-month SSRI discontinuation proportion: **0.5843** (**58.4%**).

Definition used:
- “New SSRI user”: first observed SSRI drug era, with ≥365 days prior observation.
- Required ≥180 days follow-up.
- “Discontinued by 6 months”: no SSRI drug era covering day 180 after initiation.

- Eligible new SSRI users: **75,687**
